## Contract Workspace (CW)

One contract’s whole paper trail on one surface: signature state, the Clause Navigator, executed version history, and modification papers — live-queried so paper created anywhere shows up without manual wiring.

### Non-goals

Not a contract EDITOR — every action routes through the commands (Request Signature, Execute, Amend). Not mounted into the shared contract.gts isolated in v1 (additive follow-up on that block).
